edges.reason: msg.sender becomes _taxWallet at construction.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source address.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
startTrading is gated by onlyOwner comparing _owner with _msgSender().
manualSwap is external with no owner check, so any msg.sender can call it.
manualSend is external with no owner check, so any msg.sender can drain contract ETH.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
startTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
block.timestamp feeds the external router swap deadline, making it miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp feeds the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the value move to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads the contract token balance via balanceOf.
balanceOf converts reflections with tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads the caller's _rOwned reflection balance.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard gets fee/reflection values from _getValues.
_transferStandard takes the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard performs SafeMath sub/add on reflection balances.
_takeTeam credits the contract's _rOwned balance.
_takeTeam converts team tokens using _getRate.
_takeTeam multiplies the team amount by the current rate.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal.
_getValues obtains token values from _getTValues.
_getValues obtains reflection values from _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate.
_getTValues multiplies and divides amounts by fee percentages.
_getRValues multiplies amounts by the rate and subtracts fees.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth (external router interaction) before finishing the token move, guarded only by _inSwap.
The router swap is an external call that could re-enter transfer logic; _inSwap/lockTheSwap is the only mitigation.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the fee wallet when above threshold.
sendETHToFee executes the external ETH transfer.
The external transfer sends ETH to _taxWallet.
manualSwap reaches the unguarded swap entry point, exploitable by any caller.
manualSend reaches the unguarded ETH drain entry point.
manualSwap triggers swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance.
manualSend triggers sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve for the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth calls the router stored in _uniswap.
startTrading finally calls the external addLiquidityETH.
startTrading creates the pair through the external factory call.
startTrading approves the router using _approve.
startTrading uses _uniswap for factory, WETH and liquidity calls.
startTrading stores the created pair address in _pair.
startTrading enables automatic swaps by setting _swapEnabled.
startTrading sets _canTrade to true.
removeBuyLimit (onlyOwner) rewrites the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount for pair buys.
_transfer checks the _inSwap reentrancy guard.
_transfer checks _swapEnabled before auto-swapping.
_transfer compares from/to against _pair.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to skip the tx limit.
constructor sets _taxWallet.
constructor sets the burn fee.
constructor sets the tax fee.
constructor binds the router address to _uniswap.
constructor assigns the entire reflection supply to the contract.
constructor sets the initial _maxTxAmount.

from argument is consumed by the internal _transfer.
to argument is consumed by the internal _transfer.
amount argument is consumed by the internal _transfer.
Token amount argument belongs to swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount argument belongs to sendETHToFee.
Sender argument belongs to _transferStandard.
Recipient argument belongs to _transferStandard.
Token amount argument belongs to _transferStandard.
Team token amount belongs to _takeTeam.
Reflection fee argument belongs to _reflectFee.
Token fee argument belongs to _reflectFee.
Token amount argument belongs to _getValues.

Contract ETH balance local is used by _transfer for the threshold check.
Swap path local is constructed and used by swapTokensForEth.
